entities.name: Friedrich Karl Wilhelm Dönitz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Friedrich Karl Wilhelm Dönitz or Doenitz was a German physician, anatomist, zoologist, and entomologist. He described numerous species of insects, ticks and worked for thirteen years in Japan where he was a professor of anatomy while also serving as the first forensic physician there.

entities.summary: Friedrich Karl Wilhelm Dönitz or Doenitz was a German physician, anatomist, zoologist, and entomologist. He described numerous species of insects, ticks and worked for thirteen years in Japan where he was a professor of anatomy while also serving as the first forensic physician there.
